decision: Use pinned NVIDIA default semantics, agreed before natural generation. Preserve global unequal head/layer allocation and native protection.

native_nvidia.gate: Low-rank sink attention, original BF16 projections and FP32 norm/sink parameters preserved
native_nvidia.score_inputs: Attention module pre-normalized input hidden states from complete system+document dense prefill only
native_nvidia.scoring_reuse: Once per document; no question or answer enters gate; masks reused unchanged across every natural question
native_nvidia.allocation: layerwise=False: global bottom-k pruned positions determine each layer count, followed by per-layer across-head bottom-k
native_nvidia.budget_denominator: L*Hkv*complete shared prefix tokens; system and document retained-pair counts reported independently
native_nvidia.protection: First4 shared-prefill positions and final2% (floor,max1) for shared length<32000; final4096 otherwise; scores set1
native_nvidia.private_kv: All question and generated token KV retained; original full absolute position_ids

author_difference.post_prefill: System prefix outside document budget; final floor(2%*doc) if doc<16000, else4096, score raised to maximum; global strict score>threshold can retain fewer due ties
author_difference.real_conflict_evidence: qualification_g3.json:20896-document,4096-window,10% target produces zero document pairs using original strict threshold rule
author_difference.optimized_chunk_prefill_eviction: Not ported. No complete original optimized implementation or speedup claim.

implementation: Dense original KV plus exact per-query-head attention masks; no physical KV gather/compaction. Preserves global allocation instead of equalizing head budgets.

qualification.cpu_tests: tests/test_fastkvzip_reference.py; native tie/allocation/protection checks, causal/private support and FP64 masked attention vs physical per-head gather
qualification.upstream_class_loading: AST extracts unchanged original gate/press method bodies, avoids old-API surrounding imports and network side effects
qualification.gate_loading: torch.load(weights_only=True) with minimal NVIDIA numpy safe_globals; file SHA256 verified

comparison_scope: Same HF stack and sampling temperature0.6/top_p0.95/no top_k/seed+question_index as A4. A2 source budget includes system prefix; A4 is document-only. Neither instrumented reference establishes vLLM application acceleration.
model_scope: Exact official Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 gate; no released compatible gate established for official30B FP8 TP2 and no transfer of4B gate.
implementation_difference_from_nvidia_fa: NVIDIA attention_patch.py searches query-dependent fake keys with exp underflow to emulate excluded indices. This reference uses an explicit exact support mask with the same native selected set. It does not reproduce that fake-key algorithm or its runtime.
